reasoning_content: The /home/dev/.ddev directory I created earlier was owned by root (because I ran it as root before chown). Let me fix the ownership.

action.command: chown -R dev:dev /home/dev/.ddev && su - dev -c 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && ddev version' 2>&1 | head -20
